blocked_by: A Format 2 framework ref that still supports the 16.x overlay, plus an MSM8992 SoC common package. Neither exists in the upstream catalog: UniXNU's main line has moved to 17.x and its devices.toml still records Lumia 950 as format = 1.
goal: Migrate to Format 2 once the prerequisites exist, without losing the behaviour proved in P0-P4.

criteria.requirement: The migration is proved by behavioural equivalence, not by tool exit codes: the same six QEMU milestones, the same staged tree file set and hashes, and the same handset checkpoint sequence before and after.
criteria.note: The roadmap's current exit ('unixnu status --json, unixnu tree and a kernel build pass') can be satisfied by a tree that no longer boots.

criteria.requirement: The last Format 1 state stays reachable as a tag so a failed migration can be reverted in one checkout.
criteria.note: No tags exist; artifacts expire in one to three days.

criteria.requirement: The framework ref, devices.toml excerpt and date of the format-1 decision are recorded, so the premise of the current architecture can be re-checked instead of remembered.
criteria.note: The 'no MSM8992 SoC common' claim is about a repository this project does not contain; nothing in the tree pins the evidence for it.
